description: This file contains utility functions and classes for manipulating Torch FX graphs, including recursive attribute access, component container class, and functions for splitting graphs by tags and moving non-tensor nodes across subgraph boundaries.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: A container class for subgraphs in FX graph splitting, holding graph, order, name, placeholders, inputs, outputs, attribute mappings, constructor args, and optional GraphModule.

methods.name: getattr_recursive
methods.description: Recursively accesses nested attributes or modules within a torch.nn.Module or object, following a dot-separated path.

methods.name: setattr_recursive
methods.description: Recursively sets a nested attribute or module within an object, following a dot-separated path.

methods.name: split_by_tags
methods.description: Splits a torch.fx.GraphModule into submodules based on node tags, creating separate components for each tag, and returns a new GraphModule with optional FQN mapping.

methods.name: move_non_tensor_nodes_on_boundary
methods.description: Rearranges non-tensor nodes that are on the boundary between subgraphs, moving them to appropriate subgraphs based on dependencies and connectivity.
